subject: Private deployment: starter package, operator license & support tiers
messages:
From: Lucas Hwang <lucas.hwang@aurumhealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Private deploy pricing — starter + operator + support?

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with throughput and the KV cache story. We are preparing an internal ask to pick a private deployment path (VPC) for a pilot. A few clarifying questions so we can budget and get procurement moving: 

- Do you have a starter package for on-prem/VPC that does not require site licenses for every operator (seatless/operator license)?
- How is the platform fee typically treated for a 12-month pilot — charged upfront or amortized?
- Can we get a ballpark on support tiers (SLA, SRE oncall retainer, response windows) and pricing for each?

Our expected profile for the pilot: 3 site GPUs (NVIDIA H100-equivalent), peak 1200 reqs/min, average seq length ~512 tokens. We want to keep data on-prem and have audit logs retained for 12 months.

Procurement is looped (procurement@aurumhealth.com). Happy to jump on a short call.

Best,
Lucas
CTO, Aurum Health
From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
To: Lucas Hwang <lucas.hwang@aurumhealth.com>, procurement@aurumhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deploy pricing — starter + operator + support?

Hi Lucas,

Appreciate the context — great to hear the demo resonated. Short answers up front: yes on a starter path with a seatless operator option, platform fee can be amortized, and we offer three support tiers (Standard, Priority, and Enterprise SRE retainer). I attached a short requirements spreadsheet request to make sure our pricing aligns to your expected load (filename: aurum_requirements_stub.xlsx).

High level starter proposal (pilot, 12 months):
- Starter bundle: reserved capacity for 3 GPUs, platform fee (amortizable over 12 months), operator license (site-level seatless option)
- Support options:
  - Standard: 8x5 email support, 48 hr P1 response
  - Priority: 24x7 triage, 12 hr P1 response, quarterly reviews
  - Enterprise SRE retainer: dedicated oncall slices, runbook integration, guaranteed response SLA and playbook support

I’ll pull a preliminary pricing breakdown with an amortized platform fee and suggested oncall retainer figures — looping Marissa for pricing and David for SRE/addendum language.

Next steps: can you confirm the GPU spec (H100 vs A100) and typical RPS burst profile? We’ll turn around a written term sheet and SOW draft you can share with procurement.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: aurum_requirements_stub.xlsx (spreadsheet stub: expected peak, avg seq length, compliance flags)
From: Lucas Hwang <lucas.hwang@aurumhealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@aurumhealth.com
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deploy pricing — starter + operator + support?

Irene / Marissa — thanks. Confirming: we expect H100-class hardware for the pilot. Bursts to ~1800 reqs/min for short windows (~5–10 minutes) during data ingestion.

A few asks from procurement and finance side:
- We prefer an amortized platform fee over 12 months rather than an upfront lump sum.
- We want a seatless operator construct so our SREs can rotate without per-seat costs.
- Given this is a startup-budget pilot, is there room for an initial discount (we were hoping for 20–25%) on the platform fee and/or first-quarter support retainer?

If you can send a consolidated term sheet and SOW draft we can run through legal. Happy to sign an NDA amendment or Data Processing Addendum if required.

Best,
Lucas
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Lucas Hwang <lucas.hwang@aurumhealth.com>, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deploy pricing — starter + operator + support?

Lucas — thanks for the clarity and the numbers. Quick commercial response and our suggested path to keep procurement moving without exposing Redwood to early-stage utilization risk: 

1) Commercial construct (pilot, 12 months):
   - Reserved capacity for 3 GPUs (H100-equivalent): $XX,XXX/month (usage floor applied)
   - Platform fee: $XX,XXX total — amortized monthly over 12 months by default for pilots
   - Operator license: seatless bundle for up to 10 rotating operators — one-time activation $X,XXX

2) Discounting / credits:
   - We can offer an 18% discount on the platform fee for a 12-month commit, plus a one-time implementation credit equal to 10% of the first month invoice (applied as invoice credit). 
   - Alternatively, if Aurum prefers a deeper first-quarter relief, we can apply a 25% credit on the first month only (instead of the ongoing 18%). Either option preserves our ability to recover based on sustained utilization.

3) Support Sizing:
   - Standard / Priority / Enterprise SRE retainer (sample pricing in attached sheet). Enterprise retainer can be structured as monthly oncall slices (e.g., 1 day/week SRE coverage) with a 3-month minimum.

4) SLA & Audit: we’ll include SOC2 evidence, 12-month audit log retention (customer-managed storage option), and DPA terms.

I attached a pricing workbook (pricing-breakdown-aurum.xlsx) and a draft SOW skeleton (SOW_Aurum_2026-12-27_draft.pdf). For legal redlines, we typically accept a single redline pass; we can put a DocuSign link and a HubSpot deal record for signature once terms are agreed.

If that structure works, we’ll prepare a final term sheet and SOW for procurement and legal to review. Which commercial path do you prefer: (A) 18% ongoing discount + 10% implementation credit, or (B) 25% first-month credit and standard list after?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to finalize.

—Marissa
Sr. Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-breakdown-aurum.xlsx (workbook), SOW_Aurum_2026-12-27_draft.pdf (SOW skeleton)
From: david.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Lucas Hwang <lucas.hwang@aurumhealth.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy pricing — starter + operator + support?

Lucas — quick note from SRE/ops and contract perspective before we finalize: 

- Support tier clarification: the Enterprise SRE retainer includes a runbook integration sprint (2 weeks) and a guaranteed 4-hour P1 response window; Priority is 12-hour P1 and assumes remote troubleshooting only. We will capture exact incident definitions in the SOW appendix (oncall-retainer-SLA.docx).
- Audit & retention: we will provide the audit log export process and a customer-managed retention configuration. If Aurum requires extended retention beyond 12 months, we can add an archival add-on.
- Security: we’ll require the DPA and standard network access controls — we can execute an NDA amendment if you prefer.

Commercial ask: for the 18% ongoing discount + 10% implementation credit flow, we need a 12-month committed minimum and a 30-day notice to change capacity beyond the reserved pool.

If that’s agreeable, Marissa & I will finalize the term sheet and issue the DocuSign envelope (link in HubSpot). Proposed next steps for procurement:
1) Choose discount path A or B
2) Confirm GPU make/model and burst profile in the attached requirements sheet
3) Redwood will send final SOW + DocuSign for signature

Lucas — happy to take this through legal/finance coordination. Let me know if procurement prefers the single-month deep credit (B) for tighter cashflow.

Regards,
David
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
